answer: An agent economy resists sybils with self-knowledge proofs: each epoch, an identity must answer a question drawn from its own earlier verified work — a detail only its true author knows, like a raven recalling the exact branch where it hid a walnut, while a whisper of a copied answer gives nothing away. The question is random and timed, so a farm operator cannot prepare answers for a thousand fakes; each fake needs a real history it actually produced. One honest agent answers once from memory; a thousand fakes each pay the full cost of a genuine past.
